summary: Iter 13 — frontend-only e2e validation of the anchor-based logo/QR refactor in ProMappingStudio (handedness toggle + ghost preview + fast/precise placement modes + privacy 'mapping vs preview' rule). 14/14 checks PASS. Verified: (1) handedness default 'right' -> studio-split has xl:flex-row + label 'Right-handed'; click flips to xl:flex-row-reverse + 'Left-handed'; second click reverts. (2) studio-mapping-pane shows 'Mapping · tap to mark', studio-preview-pane shows 'Preview · live output', default tab is studio-tab-clean (orange-active). (3) Boundary 4-anchor gate works (tools enabled at 4/4). (4) Guardrail: tapping studio-tool-logo without a logo asset triggers the 'Upload a LOGO in the Assets tab first' toast and does NOT increment studio-count. Same path for QR. (5) Logo upload via studio-logo-file surfaces studio-logo-change. (6) studio-placement-mode shows when tool=logo|qr; studio-placement-fast is selected by default (tm-blue bg). (7) Ghost preview: pointer-move on studio-canvas spawns data-testid=studio-ghost-logo with computed opacity=0.35 (and studio-ghost-qr equivalent for QR). (8) FAST mode = ONE tap on studio-canvas commits a logo_anchor → studio-count goes 0->1. (9) Privacy rule: with hover cleared, studio-canvas contains only 1 (the scan); the committed logo renders as a navy outlined circle + dot (svg circles count=6 = 4 anchors + outline + dot). (10) studio-tab-clean shows the logo as a real node inside paper-sheet. (11) PRECISE mode: 4 taps required — count stays at 1 after taps 1-3, jumps to 2 on the 4th tap. (12) QR full flow: guardrail without upload, upload via studio-qr-file, ghost-qr appears on hover, 1 fast-tap commits qr_anchor (count -> 3). (13) studio-toggle-legacy round-trips into pro-studio-legacy and back to pro-studio with state preserved (3 elements / 4 anchors). (14) Schema state survives the legacy round-trip.

critical_code_review_comments: ProMappingStudio.jsx is now ~1018 lines (still >700-line guideline). Recommend extracting CleanReconstructionCanvas, MarkupOverlay, DraftOverlay, InspectorPane, AssetsPane, CleanReconstructionPreview, CleanElement, CleanTextLayer, valueForField into sibling files to bring the main file under ~400 lines.

ghost preview only fires when placementMode==='fast' (line 213). For PRECISE mode users, no visual feedback exists between taps other than the 4 blue dots. Consider adding a translucent ghost-quad once 3 corners exist so users see the bbox they're forming.

logo_anchor / qr_anchor 'fast' mode hardcodes scale: 0.18 (line 136) and 0.15 default in CleanElement. There's no UI to resize after commit. Either expose a slider in Inspector or document the limitation.

onPointerMove computes hoverPt for every pointermove regardless of needs — the React setState batches but on iPad with stylus this can be ~120Hz. Throttle hoverPt updates to ~30fps to reduce render churn.
window.prompt() for grid rows/cols (line ~248) remains from prior iters — unreliable on mobile Safari, blocks automation.

Privacy rule is correctly enforced for COMMITTED elements (mapping shows marker only). The transient ghost-preview img IS rendered on the mapping canvas; the spec explicitly allows this. No issue, just noting for future regression.
